summary: Tested iteration 14 features: PDF page numbering (X de Y), cover table bold labels, 1.2cm margins, bigger logo (4.5cm), multiple file selection, no OS in header center, subsection buttons only on parent sections, NDT no photo upload (subsections have it), PDF upload conversion, image compression. All backend tests passed (12/12). Frontend verified via Playwright.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated - use 'boxShadow'

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 14 features verified: PDF page numbers 'X de Y' starting from page 2 (cover has none), cover table labels bold (value_style non-bold), 1.2cm content margins, 4.5cm logo, multiple file selection, no OS number in PDF header center, 'Adicionar Subseção' only on parent sections not subsections, NDT section has no photo upload (subsections do), PDF upload converts to images, image compression quality 45/60.

feature_1_pdf_page_numbers_x_de_y.evidence: PyMuPDF verification: Page 0 (cover) has NO page number, Page 1 has '1 de 2', Page 2 has '2 de 2'. Code: server.py lines 1941-1960 uses PyMuPDF post-processing to add page numbers starting from index 1.

feature_2_cover_table_bold_labels.evidence: Code: server.py line 1711 label_style uses fontName='Helvetica-Bold', line 1712 value_style uses fontName='Helvetica' (non-bold). Lines 1773-1779 apply these styles correctly.

feature_3_wider_margins_1_2cm.evidence: Code: server.py lines 1587-1588 set content_left=1.2*cm and content_right=1.2*cm

feature_4_bigger_logo_4_5cm.evidence: Code: server.py line 1638 drawImage with width=4.5*cm

feature_5_multiple_file_selection.evidence: Code: edit-report.tsx line 245 has input with 'multiple' attribute. UI test confirmed file input has multiple=true.

feature_6_no_os_in_header_center.evidence: Code: server.py lines 1640-1644 show header center only has report_title and '20-FR-01-03 (1)', no OS number.

feature_7_subsections_no_adicionar_btn.evidence: Code: edit-report.tsx lines 347-359 show 'Adicionar Subseção' button is only inside {editingSection === sec.key} block (parent sections only), not in subsection rendering (lines 326-345).

feature_8_ndt_no_photo_upload.evidence: Code: edit-report.tsx line 16 NO_PHOTO_SECTIONS includes 'ndt'. Line 18 NO_TEXT_SECTIONS includes 'ndt'. Line 20 PDF_UPLOAD_SECTIONS includes 'ndt' (subsections get photo upload). UI verified 'ndt' section has no direct photo upload.

feature_9_pdf_upload_to_images.evidence: Code: server.py lines 1394-1404 convert_pdf_to_images() function uses PyMuPDF (fitz) to convert PDF pages to JPEG images at 150 DPI.

feature_10_image_compression.evidence: Code: server.py line 1739 uses quality=45 for PDF photos, lines 1442 and 1483 use quality=60 for general uploads.

feature_11_visualizar_baixar_pdf_buttons.evidence: UI test confirmed 'Visualizar PDF' and 'Baixar PDF' buttons visible on edit report page. Screenshots show outlined and solid button styles.

feature_12_periodo_e_informacoes_removed.evidence: UI test confirmed 'Período e Informações' section NOT present on edit report page. Code review confirms no periodo card in edit-report.tsx.
